description: Classify every Maestro flow over a lookback window into healthy, flaky, broken, or regression, ranked worst-first, so you can tell whether a failure is worth fixing before diving in. Regressions (a flow that was passing and recently started failing) are surfaced first, since a recent change likely broke them. Use this to prioritize, then diagnose_run to fix a specific run. Filters mirror list_flow_analytics.

appId.description: Filter by app bundle id, e.g. com.example.app.

endDate.description: ISO 8601 end of range. Defaults to now.

startDate.description: ISO 8601 start of range. Overrides days.

name: suite_health
